# CG-API-003: Operation path changed (probable rename)

A removed operation matches an added one by operationId or a case/trailing-slash difference.

**Why it matters:** A moved operation is a removal for existing consumers even when the functionality survives.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `operation.probableRename` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Operation {from} appears to have moved to {to}.
>
> Consumers still calling {from} will fail; the match was found by {evidenceKind}.
>
> **Fix:** Keep {from} as a deprecated alias of {to}, or release the move as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: moved with the same operationId

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /user: {get: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /users: {get: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Operation GET /user appears to have moved to GET /users.

### Fires: trailing slash removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /users/: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /users: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Operation GET /users/ appears to have moved to GET /users.

### Does not fire: same operationId on a different method

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /user: {get: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /users: {post: {operationId: getUser, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: duplicate operationIds suppress the hint

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /user: {get: {operationId: dup, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
-   /other: {get: {operationId: dup, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /users: {get: {operationId: dup, responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /other: {get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- The match is a heuristic; it never hides the removal, it only explains it.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-003
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-API-003: { severity: low }
```
